'''Detention Center A''' was a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]. The camp also consisted of five Imperial [[Fortress/Legends|fortresses]] and other military buildings. After the Empire lost the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]<ref name="GB" /> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> it was decided to abandon Kessel and the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] factories were shut down. The [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] from Detention Center A were forced to keep working in the thinning air. Shortly after, a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Army/Legends|army]] led by [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] [[Liberation of Kessel|arrived]] on Kessel and re-powered the atmosphere factories and liberated the slaves from Detention Center A, [[Detention Center B]], and [[Detention Center C]].<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Detention Center A was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]] for the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''. It appeared in the Chewbacca campaign's bonus mission. The player was tasked with re-powering the atmosphere factories, and may ignore the military buildings in Detention Center A, which is what the strategy guide recommends.<ref name="GB" />
